description: Creates a DRAFT version of the agent that can be used for internal testing.

researchLinks.description: Detecting AWS Bedrock Abuse: From LLMjacking to the Hidden Attack Vectors

securityImplications: Attackers might use PrepareAgent to activate a Bedrock agent they have modified (for example with a rewritten prompt or a malicious action group), making the change take effect without redeploying the application.
